label: TEST DATA: correspondence-first Overview verification
method: Built React UI, actual loopback Node API, synthetic host principal, fresh disposable owner SQLite and fresh owned headless Chrome. Existing importer; no live source or production identity.

observations.name: Empty states distinguish missing stored data from empty original sources
Offset-aware message chronology; date-only/unknown records remain separate
Original source link and unknown review time retained; no actor/delivery inference
Ongoing and all-day records selected; past/subscription/inferred/cancelled/declined/unknown-status/invalid-zone excluded
Only explicitly flagged requests shown; paused status preserved
Keyboard request link focuses exact record
Deep link and exact focus survive reload
Read navigation and reload leave durable records and audits unchanged
Next-event jump reaches focused section without changing routes
320px/375px long-text layout, section jumps and exact request navigation pass
UI save persists once as saved-not-delivered across reload
Failed refresh retains prior snapshot with explicit error
API readback preserves 19 domain records plus import receipt; bridge remains disconnected
Newer persisted cancellation removes former next event and reveals next eligible event
No external requests or application JavaScript errors

harnessNotes: Initial run stopped after seven observations: navigation selector omitted its icon. Its Node wrapper was v22; final run uses explicit Node 26.11.1.
Second run stopped after twelve observations: exact descendant text selector did not match the alert container with its retry button. Corrected to inspect the alert text.
Both interrupted runs closed owned browser/server/storage and are not represented as final acceptance.

Source review removed query/filter from request-focus effect dependencies to preserve editing focus. Section-jump controls were added after visual review. Final runtime source was rebuilt and all 18 observations rerun.

checks.tests: 14 existing tests passed on final runtime code under Node 26
